metadata.description: Three production-grade Claude Code plugins by Omer Yehuda: Army (a chief of staff, 18 specialist units and 8 standalone drills), Studio (an AI film crew for explainers, cartoon shorts and realistic films) and Skill Installer (every skill scanned, pinned and locked).

plugins.name: army
plugins.description: A chief of staff that commands 18 specialist units as subagents, plus 8 drills you can run on their own: trial (decisions), admit (bugs), taste (reviews), countdown (releases), exam (skill evals), recall (records), edition (release notes) and lanes (parallel sessions). 110+ on-demand playbooks, cost-aware model routing, safety gates and local memory.

plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: A film crew of AI agents in three formats: kinetic-typography explainers with AI narration and a trend desk, animated cartoon shorts from true stories with Hebrew RTL captions (formerly toon-shorts), and realistic short films from stills you generate (formerly Premiere). One install, one hash-locked venv, one voice model.

plugins.name: skill-installer
plugins.description: Install Claude skills from GitHub the safe way: a customs scan gates every install (CLEARED installs, SECONDARY INSPECTION asks, DENIED never installs), files come from one pinned commit, skills.lock.json records hashes, and audit rescans what you have. Includes the Customs inspector.
